run_tls_cert_installer: run the TLS certificate installer script to write server certificates and private keys to disk
get_env_var_if_set: get an environment variable value or return a default value if the variable is not set
write_content_to_file: write string content to a file at the given path creating parent directories as needed
get_secret_from_aws: retrieve a secret value from AWS Secrets Manager by secret ID and region
set_boto_log_level: set the logging level for boto3, boto, and botocore loggers to reduce verbose output
